summary.what_it_is: Auto Ontology is a Python framework that builds a semantic, graph-based reasoning layer over enterprise data. It generates ontologies from metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes a context layer via MCP, CLI, and API so agents can reliably translate natural language to SQL and retrieve grounded answers.
summary.why_trending: No clear reason in the project's own text.
summary.who_its_for: Developers and data teams building agentic analytics or LLM workflows that need a trusted semantic layer over relational databases.
